data.title: 五河琴里 · 夏日浪花红白条纹比基尼的灵动笑颜
data.description: 阳光璀璨的蔚蓝海滩，琴里身穿红白细条纹挂脖比基尼，含着棒棒糖在海浪中奔跑，双马尾随着步伐如赤色火焰般跳跃。
data.action: 踏着飞溅的白浪奔跑，单手轻按泳衣下摆，侧头露出调皮灿烂的笑容
data.lighting: 强烈的夏日阳光照耀，海面如碎金般闪耀
data.camera: 抓拍平视动态全景，极富夏日海边动感
data.promptProse: Kotori Itsuka dashes energetically across the shimmering white sands into the frothy sea foam on a sun-drenched summer beach. Wearing a lively red-and-white candy-striped halterneck bikini, her fiery crimson twintails whip excitedly in the ocean gale. Splashing clear sea water with bare feet, she glances back over her shoulder with an uninhibited, mischievous grin under the tropical sky.
data.animaCaption: Kotori dashes through the shallow waves in her red-and-white striped bikini, looking back with a bright, energetic laugh.
